meta.note: Generated from features/*.feature by testcases/build.js. Every scenario carries @case:N; an N missing here is an error.

1.title: The store has the documented tables
steps: Then the store has tables assets, pairs, accounts, balances, ledger, transfers, swaps, bridge_ops

2.title: A balance can never be negative
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting a balance with a negative amount fails a CHECK

3.title: A ledger movement is a real, non-zero change with a known reason
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting a ledger row with zero delta fails a CHECK
And inserting a ledger row with reason "bogus" fails a CHECK

4.title: A balance references a real account and asset
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting a balance for a missing account fails a FOREIGN KEY

5.title: A bridge op is unique per direction and external tx
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting two deposit bridge ops with the same external tx fails on the second

6.title: A pair's two legs must differ
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting a pair whose base equals its quote fails a CHECK

7.title: Seeding twice leaves the same rows
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema and seed applied
Then applying the seed again changes no row counts

8.title: A deposit credits the balance and writes a matching ledger line
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
Then the balance row for "alice" in BTC is 1.0 BTC
And a ledger line credits "alice" 1.0 BTC with reason "deposit"

9.title: The ledger sum equals the running balance
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When "alice" deposits 2.0 ETH
And "alice" withdraws 0.5 ETH
Then the ledger sum for "alice" in ETH equals the balance row

10.title: An internal transfer conserves the total balance
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And a fresh account "bob"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" transfers 0.4 BTC to "bob"
Then the balance row for "alice" in BTC is 0.6 BTC
And the balance row for "bob" in BTC is 0.4 BTC
And the total BTC across "alice" and "bob" is unchanged

11.title: A swap debits the input and credits the net output, both on the ledger
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" swaps 0.5 BTC to USD
Then the ledger sum for "alice" in BTC equals the balance row
And the ledger sum for "alice" in USD equals the balance row
And "alice" has a swap row from BTC to USD

12.title: A bridge withdrawal locks the balance with a debit line
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And "alice" deposits 1.0 BTC
When "alice" bridge-withdraws 0.3 BTC to chain "ethereum"
Then the balance row for "alice" in BTC is 0.7 BTC
And a ledger line debits "alice" 0.3 BTC with reason "bridge_debit"
And the bridge op for "alice" is in status "locked"

13.title: A bridge deposit credits once even when observed twice
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
When a bridge deposit of 1.0 ETH for "alice" from chain "ethereum" with tx "dep-x" is observed
And the same bridge deposit is observed again
Then the balance row for "alice" in ETH is 1.0 ETH
And "alice" has exactly one bridge op with external tx "dep-x"

14.title: An overdrawn transfer leaves both balances untouched
steps: Given a fresh account "alice"
And a fresh account "bob"
And "alice" deposits 0.2 BTC
When "alice" tries to transfer 5.0 BTC to "bob"
Then the transfer is refused with code "insufficient_funds"
And the balance row for "alice" in BTC is 0.2 BTC
And "bob" has no BTC balance row

15.title: The exchange lists its assets
steps: When the assets are read
Then the asset list includes BTC, ETH, SOL, USD
And every listed asset has a name and a USD price

16.title: The exchange lists its tradable pairs
steps: When the pairs are read
Then the pair list includes BTC/USD and ETH/USD
And no pair has the same asset on both legs

17.title: A quote returns the net after fee
steps: When a quote of 1.0 BTC to USD is requested
Then the quote net equals the gross minus the fee
And the quote fee matches the pair fee in basis points

And the response code is "slippage"

62.title: A limit order that does not cross rests on the book
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
When "maker" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the order status is "open"
And the order book has an ask of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD

63.title: Placing a sell reserves the base it offers
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
When "maker" places a limit sell of 0.4 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the reserved BTC of "maker" is 0.4

64.title: A crossing taker matches the maker at the maker's price
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 100000.0 USD
And "maker" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
When "taker" places a limit buy of 0.5 BTC at 61000 USD
Then the order status is "filled"
And a fill records 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD

65.title: A match moves base to the taker and quote to the maker
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 100000.0 USD
And "maker" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
When "taker" places a limit buy of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the ledger sum for "taker" in BTC equals the balance row
And the ledger sum for "maker" in USD equals the balance row
And the API balance for "maker" in BTC is 0.5 BTC

66.title: The taker pays the taker fee and the maker pays the maker fee
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 100000.0 USD
And "maker" places a limit sell of 1.0 BTC at 60000 USD
When "taker" places a limit buy of 1.0 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the last fill taker fee is 20 basis points of 1.0 BTC
And the last fill maker fee is 10 basis points of 60000.0 USD

67.title: A partial fill leaves the remainder resting
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 100000.0 USD
And "maker" places a limit sell of 1.0 BTC at 60000 USD
When "taker" places a limit buy of 0.3 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the taker order status is "filled"
And the maker order for "maker" is "partial" with filled 0.3 BTC

68.title: Matching takes the best price first
steps: Given a fresh account "m1" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "m2" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 100000.0 USD
And "m1" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 61000 USD
And "m2" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
When "taker" places a limit buy of 0.5 BTC at 61000 USD
Then a fill records 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD

69.title: A taker never matches its own resting order
steps: Given a fresh account "trader" funded with 100000.0 USD
And "trader" places a limit buy of 0.1 BTC at 60000 USD
And "trader" is funded with 1.0 BTC
When "trader" places a limit sell of 0.1 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the order status is "open"
And the order filled is 0.0 BTC

70.title: Cancelling an order releases its reserve
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
And "maker" places a limit sell of 0.6 BTC at 60000 USD
When "maker" cancels the order
Then the order status is "cancelled"
And the reserved BTC of "maker" is 0.0

71.title: A post-only order that would cross is rejected
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 100000.0 USD
And "maker" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
When "taker" places a post-only buy of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the response status is 409
And the response code is "would_cross"

72.title: A fill-or-kill order that cannot fully fill is killed
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 200000.0 USD
And "maker" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
When "taker" places a FOK buy of 2.0 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the response status is 409
And the response code is "fok_unfilled"

steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 200000.0 USD
And "maker" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
When "taker" places an IOC buy of 2.0 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the order status is "cancelled"
And the order filled is 0.5 BTC

74.title: A market buy sweeps the book at the resting price
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 100000.0 USD
And "maker" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD
When "taker" places a market buy of 0.5 BTC paying USD
Then the order status is "filled"
And a fill records 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD

75.title: A match conserves value across the two sides
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 2.0 ETH
And a fresh account "taker" funded with 100000.0 USD
And "maker" places a limit sell of 2.0 ETH at 2500 USD
When "taker" places a limit buy of 2.0 ETH at 2500 USD
Then the base leaving the maker equals the base reaching the taker plus the taker fee
And the quote leaving the taker equals the quote reaching the maker plus the maker fee

And a higher tier pays the maker a rebate

77.title: A below-minimum order is refused
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
When "maker" places a limit sell of 0.00001 BTC at 60000 USD
Then the response status is 400
And the response code is "below_min"

78.title: A repeated order with the same idempotency key makes one order
steps: Given a fresh account "maker" funded with 1.0 BTC
When "maker" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD with key "ord-1"
And "maker" places a limit sell of 0.5 BTC at 60000 USD with key "ord-1"
Then the second order was an idempotent replay
And the open orders of "maker" number 1

And the minted key has scope "trade"

And the response code is "wrong_scope"

And "alice" holds a "withdraw" API key

And "alice" holds a "trade" API key

85.title: An unknown key is rejected

And the response code is "rate_limited"

And "alice" holds a "trade" API key
When the key tries to mint a "withdraw" API key

And "alice" holds a "read" API key
When the keys of "alice" are read

89.title: A stake principal must be positive
steps: Given a throwaway database with the schema applied
Then inserting a stake with a non-positive principal fails a CHECK

steps: Given a fresh account "alice" funded with 1.0 BTC
When "alice" stakes 0.6 BTC at 500 bps
Then the response status is 201
And the API balance for "alice" in BTC is 0.4 BTC

When "alice" stakes 2.0 ETH at 800 bps
Then a ledger line debits "alice" 2.0 ETH with reason "stake_lock"

93.title: Accrual is proportional to the elapsed time

And "alice" stakes 100.0 USDC at 1000 bps

94.title: Redeeming returns the principal plus the reward

And "alice" stakes 100.0 USDC at 1000 bps
And the stake accrues 31536000 seconds
When the stake is redeemed

And "alice" stakes 100.0 USDC at 1000 bps
And the stake accrues 31536000 seconds
And the stake is redeemed

And the API balance for "alice" in USDC is 110.0 USDC

And the response code is "insufficient_funds"

97.title: A redeemed stake's ledger balances back to whole
steps: Given a fresh account "alice" funded with 100.0 USDC
And "alice" stakes 100.0 USDC at 1000 bps
And the stake accrues 31536000 seconds
And the stake is redeemed
Then the ledger sum for "alice" in USDC equals the balance row

And "alice" stakes 0.8 BTC at 500 bps

And the response code is "insufficient_funds"

steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread
When the market maker quotes
Then the quote is placed
And the bid is below the reference and the ask is above it

steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread
When the market maker quotes
Then the order book shows the maker's bid and ask
And the maker has exactly one bid and one ask resting

Then the maker has exactly one bid and one ask resting
And the resting ask is at the new ask price

105.title: When a taker lifts the ask, the maker's ask fills
steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread
And the market maker quotes
When a taker lifts the maker's ask
Then the maker's ask order is filled

106.title: The kill switch stops the maker from quoting
steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread with the kill switch on

107.title: Dry-run plans a quote without sending it
steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread in dry-run mode
When the market maker quotes
Then the quote is a dry run
And the maker has no resting quotes
And the maker's token does not leak into a log line

108.title: A quote writes one open bid and one open ask
steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread
When the market maker quotes
Then the store has one open bid and one open ask for the maker

109.title: The bid reserves quote and the ask reserves base
steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread
When the market maker quotes
Then the maker's reserved BTC covers the ask and reserved USD covers the bid

110.title: A lifted ask writes a fill and advances the order
steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread
And the market maker quotes
When a taker lifts the maker's ask
Then a fill row records the ask size at the ask price
And the maker's ask order filled equals its size in the store

111.title: Repricing cancels the old orders and releases their reserve
steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread
And the market maker quotes
When the market maker reprices to 61000
Then the maker has exactly two cancelled orders in the store
And the maker's reserved funds cover only the new quote

112.title: The maker's ledger balances after quote, fill and reprice
steps: Given a funded market maker on BTC/USD at reference 60000 with 50 bps spread
And the market maker quotes
